scope: Read-only census of payment names, checkout identifiers, SDK/plugin markers, and provider integrations already captured in the 48-store checkout dataset and 570-domain public crawl. No new transaction, order, account, credential, PII, or gate-bypass activity was performed.

correction.tooAbsoluteWording: Zero processor/acquirer chains were independently verified.
correction.whyItIsTooAbsolute: The datasets do verify named provider integrations in public code, including PSP/PayFac/processor-level brands such as Stripe, Square, Airwallex, WooPayments, PayPal, Amazon Pay, QuickBooks Payments, and Affirm. Some provider IDs were also returned as active for an anonymous Reta cart. What remains unverified is the merchant's contractual processor/ISO/acquirer chain, transaction success, and settlement.
correction.safeReplacement: Public code verifies named payment integrations—and some active Reta-cart method IDs—but not the merchant's contractual processor/ISO/acquirer chain or successful settlement.

publicCodeCanEstablish: A named SDK, script host, WooCommerce plugin, CSS/JS bundle, or checkout method identifier is exposed.
For active_for_reta_cart_api rows, the public cart API returned that identifier after an anonymous Reta cart add.
For configured_not_active_for_reta_cart rows, the integration was exposed/configured but unavailable for the tested cart.
publicCodeCannotEstablishAlone: That the merchant owns an approved and durable account with the named provider.
The legal merchant of record, ISO/MSP, acquiring processor, sponsor/acquiring bank, MCC, reserves, limits, or underwriting terms.
That a charge can be authorized, captured, settled, or survive future risk review.

Stripe.role: Gateway, PSP, payment facilitator under applicable programs, and payment processor.

Square.role: Integrated PSP/payment facilitator and end-to-end processor with a built-in gateway.

PayPal.role: Payment service provider and payment processor.

NMI.role: Payment gateway that can connect to many downstream processors; the processor is not inferable from the NMI signal.

Authorize.Net.role: Payment gateway; Gateway Only can connect to an existing merchant account, so the processor/MSP is not inferable from code.

Bankful.role: Payment software/orchestration; PayFac and processor-of-record roles are arrangement-specific.

Link Money.role: Open-banking Pay by Bank platform delivered through an SDK/API.

eDebit Direct.role: ACH, eCheck, and demand-draft service provider that describes itself as a payment processor for those bank-payment services.

Paynote.role: API-based merchant-services/payment platform; exact processing and bank partners are arrangement-specific.
